area: MOBILITY / ATTACK / PKI seams + plugin-ability of the config system and packaging (pure-Python engine src/scms_sim_ref/mock_pipeline/run.py @ 4125 lines, scms_core/, AttackLib.java, gui/server.py, pyproject.toml)
current_seams:
VERDICT: there is NO plugin machinery anywhere. `grep -rn "entry_points|importlib|plugin|__subclasses__|Protocol|ABC|abstractmethod"` over src/, gui/, tools/ returns ZERO hits (only tests load tools/verify_data.py by path). Everything below is a de-facto seam, not a designed one.

(1) SCHEMA SELF-DESCRIPTION — the one genuinely automatic surface. config_schema() run.py:1860-1888 walks dataclasses.fields(PipelineConfig) and joins _ENUM_OPTIONS run.py:1639-1650 + _FIELD_META run.py:1654-1857 + _field_group run.py:1610-1635 into {type,default,group,widget,help,options,min,max,step,unit}. Live count: 138 fields, _FIELD_META covers all 138 (0 missing). Consumers that need zero code per field: GUI advanced panel (/api/schema gui/server.py:1173), copilot cheat-sheet/set_config/sweep/compare, --dump-config-schema run.py:3997-4002, manifest capture run.py:3785.
(2) CONFIG ROUND-TRIP — config_from_dict run.py:1891-1918 accepts raw dict OR manifest.json ("config" key), coerces _TUPLE_FIELDS run.py:1607, ignores unknown keys with a stderr warning run.py:1902-1904. _write_manifest run.py:3779-3802 stores the full effective cfg.__dict__; `--config` replay run.py:4003-4013 and GUI config-replay gui/server.py:924-935 both go through it.
(3) TELEMETRY HOOKS — PER_STEP_HOOK / LANE_CHANGE_HOOK / GAP_YIELD_HOOK, module globals run.py:1929-1937, documented digest-neutral, called at run.py:3093-3094, 2922-2928, 3027-3030. Read-only observation; none can write simulation state.
(4) ROAD-NETWORK DUCK-TYPE PROTOCOL — the closest thing to a working plugin today. Dispatch run.py:1990-2006 on cfg.road_network; the informal interface a network must satisfy is nodes/center/_coord/node_phase/dist_to_road/random_trip/geometry/stats + optional set_closures (hasattr-probed run.py:2265, 2281). `road_network="custom"` + a custom_network JSON document (run.py:2004-2006, roads.py:373-681, validated in validate_config run.py:1567-1569) already lets a user inject an arbitrary map with no fork — the precedent for "supply a document, get behaviour".
(5) TRIP PROTOCOL — roads.py:23-100. Vehicle.trip is consumed through exactly 7 members: length, t1, speed, caps, at_distance, state, next_node, next_turn, cap_at (call sites run.py:1116-1117, 3014, 3032, 3036-3037, 3043-3046). This is the narrow seam the roadmap's frozen-trajectory SUMO backend targets (docs/realism/ROADMAP.md §3.1).
(6) CHANNEL MODEL AS A CLASS — GeometricChannel run.py:530-711 has a real narrow surface (begin_step / cbr / collision_loss / evaluate) and its own keyed RNG (run.py:611, 693). Reached via a hard `if cfg.radio_model == "geometric"` run.py:3063-3065 + branch at 3325-3355.
(7) DATA-DRIVEN ATTACK SELECTION (composition only) — attack_types tuple run.py:725, attack_mix weights run.py:171-190, attack_magnitude_scale run.py:202-227, all validated against KNOWN_ATTACK_TYPES run.py:103. Users can freely recompose the ~25 shipped attacks; they cannot add one.
(8) KEYED-RNG CONVENTION — `random.Random(f"{seed}:label:{id}")` at run.py:2055, 2067, 2145, 2148, 2150, 2181, 2251, 2287-2301, 2332, 2335, 2400, 2938, 3352, 3563, 611, 693. An established, order-independent discipline any plugin can adopt.
(9) JAVA SIDE HAS A HALF-REGISTRY — AttackLib.java:39-118 builds FAMILIES/BASES/CATALOG in a static block from name arrays × PROFILES × TIERS (~291 variants); resolve/enabled/assign AttackLib.java:131-186 are selected by env SCMS_ATTACKS. The catalogue is data; the behaviour is still a switch.
(10) MODULE-BOUNDARY CRYPTO — run.py:44 imports crypto_abstract as `ca` and calls only 4 functions (keypair_from_seed, public_bytes, hashed_id8, canonical_bytes) at run.py:2099-2100, 2154-2155, 2192-2193, 2347-2348, 2735-2739, 3723. Swapping the module is a one-line import change; that IS today's "abstraction".

* Motion lives in three mutually exclusive inline branches of Vehicle.true_state run.py:1112-1130 (cf → cur_x/cur_y/cur_v/cur_h; trip → trip.state(t); else closed-form straight line + sinusoidal wander).
* car_follow run.py:2952-3055 is a ~100-line CLOSURE defined inside run_pipeline over cfg/net/_lights/_gap/_turn/_lane_changes/lc_rng/_CF_CELL — not importable, not overridable, not addressable. Same for _idm_accel run.py:2825-2834, _mobil_decide 2836-2928, _lane_step 2930-2950, _light_green 2817-2823, gap-acceptance priority 2965-2992, turn slowdown 3031-3034, per-edge caps 3036-3039, measure 2404-2428.
* The ENTIRE fleet is constructed before step 0: flow thinning loop run.py:2251-2282 or fixed fleet 2284-2307, both calling make_vehicle run.py:2054-2171 (which also does cert provisioning and attack assignment). The step loop only activates from pre-sorted spawn_order run.py:3075, 3101-3102 and despawns on finish_time 3103-3107. A live external engine that creates vehicles mid-run has no seam at all.

* Rendering = one if/elif chain on `typ` inside attack_claim run.py:2430-2544 (20 branches, closure over vrng/mag_scale/cfg). An unknown type silently returns honest values (fallthrough to run.py:2544) — no error.

* DETECTORS are equally closed — this is exactly where the user's "thresholding" plugin lands. detectors() run.py:2549-2568 returns a fixed 6-key dict; 6 more are computed inline run.py:3450-3466 and 2 more in the VRU branch 3513-3520; DET_KEYS run.py:2570-2584 is a literal tuple conditionally extended by two feature flags; SOFT_KEYS 2587; and featurize.DETECTORS featurize.py:57-62 is a THIRD hand-copied list (featurize.py:35-53 a fourth). Firing is a fixed streak+threshold rule run.py:3521-3528 (`det[k] >= 1.0` for MIN_CONSEC consecutive receptions). Adding a scheme today = editing run.py + featurize.py.
* Java taxonomy is a parallel, hand-synchronized universe (featurize.py:65 comment "mirrors org.scms.attacks.AttackLib"): switch(v.base) AttackLib.java:332+ over ~30 bases; magnitudes from bare env vars AttackLib.java:225-250 with silent NumberFormatException fallback; no shared schema with PipelineConfig.

PKI/SCMS — thinner than it looks.
* The three authorities are dict wrappers with no interface and no config knob: LinkageAuthority run.py:976-990, PseudonymCA 993-1004, RegistrationAuthority 1007-1025, instantiated concretely at run.py:1945.
* Issuance is inlined in make_vehicle run.py:2095-2113: n_rot from rotate_period_s, indices `i_k, j_k = k // jmax, (vid + k) % jmax` run.py:2098, keys from ca.keypair_from_seed(cfg.derive(f"key:{vid}:{k}")) run.py:2099 where derive = sha256(f"{seed}|{label}")[:n] run.py:969-970. la_id1/la_id2 hardcoded 0x0001/0x0002 run.py:2057.
* Pseudonym-change policy is ONE strategy: fixed period, index-by-elapsed-time, Vehicle.active_pseudonym run.py:1105-1110. Silent-period, distance-based, context/mix-zone-triggered changes are not expressible at any seam.
* crypto_abstract.py IS NOT AN ABSTRACTION. 74 lines, 6 free functions, hard-bound to Ed25519 (crypto_abstract.py:22-25, 43-47, 63-74); no ABC/Protocol/registry. Worse: sign() crypto_abstract.py:63 and verify() crypto_abstract.py:67 are NEVER CALLED anywhere in src/ (grep confirmed) — Vehicle.priv is always None and Vehicle.pub always b"" (run.py:2122, 2350), and `sig_ok` is a synthetic boolean set by the InvalidSignature branch run.py:3156-3157 and read as a flag at run.py:3395, 3480. No signature is ever produced or verified on the dataset path. "Swap in a different PKI" today reduces to swapping a key-derivation + an 8-byte digest function.
* butterfly.py (120 lines, CAMP SCP1 caterpillar/cocoon/PCA-certify) and ec.py (P-256 group ops) are DEAD in the pipeline — the only importers are tests/test_butterfly.py. The real butterfly provisioning flow is never exercised in a dataset run.
* linkage.py IS live and load-bearing (DeviceLinkageContext.linkage_value_for run.py:2110, 2158; CrlLinkageEntry run.py:2700-2701; la1/la2.seed_at run.py:2697-2698) but imported by name run.py:45 with byte-widths as module constants linkage.py:33-37 — no injection point.
* Standards conformance is a manifest STRING, not a check: run.py:3794-3795 emits standards_profile {"report":"ETSI TS 103 759 (shape)","cert":"IEEE 1609.2","linkage":"CAMP SCP2"}. MaReport records.py:94-114 is TS-103-759-shaped but is a plain dataclass with ad-hoc extra keys bolted on after to_dict() run.py:2623-2642; detector_outputs carries only reasons[0] run.py:2617-2618 and cert_validity is hardcoded all-True run.py:2619 regardless of the actual sig_valid passed in.

CONFIG SYSTEM — a plugin cannot declare a field today.
* config_schema() iterates dataclasses.fields(PipelineConfig) run.py:1865 — the field set is closed at class-definition time.
* validate_config run.py:1399-1603 is ~200 lines of hand-written per-field ifs plus _PROB_FIELDS clamping run.py:1370-1372, 1601-1602. No per-field validator registry.
* CLI hand-declares ~110 argparse flags run.py:3815-3978 and hand-threads them into ONE 65-line PipelineConfig(...) call run.py:4014-4078; omitting either half silently drops the knob. Flag names diverge from field names (--radio-range↔radio_range_m, --grid↔grid_w, --denm-implausible-speed↔denm_implausible_speed_mps, pinned by tests/test_gui_curated_knobs.py:17).
* CLI_PRESETS run.py:1377-1396 are keyed by argparse DEST, not field name, forcing gui/agent.py:_DEST_TO_FIELD translation.
* GUI CONFIG_SPEC gui/server.py:82-690 is a FOURTH hand-maintained declaration (~40 python-flow entries carrying gen/arg + ~55 MOSAIC env/param entries), regrouped by _PF_GROUP gui/server.py:~660-694, launched by _start_python_flow gui/server.py:888-921 which emits one CLI arg per non-empty pf_* value. Parity is enforced only by tests, not by construction.
* CRITICAL for constraint (2): config_from_dict DROPS unknown keys with only a stderr warning run.py:1902-1904, and the manifest serializes a flat cfg.__dict__ run.py:3785 with no namespace, no plugin identity, no plugin version/hash. A plugin-configured run written today would replay SILENTLY WRONG from its own manifest.

PACKAGING — installable, but only half the project.
* pyproject.toml: setuptools>=68, name "scms-sim-ref" 0.1.0, requires-python >=3.11, deps ["cryptography>=42","pydantic>=2"], packages.find where=["src"], package-data only for scms_sim_ref.datagen refdata/*.json, one console script `scms-poc = scms_sim_ref.mock_pipeline.run:main` (pyproject.toml:22-23). No [project.entry-points] group of any kind.
* Declared-vs-actual dependency drift: pydantic is declared but imported NOWHERE (grep: 0 hits); numpy is imported by 6 datagen modules (benchmark.py:21, calibration.py:21, corpus_report.py:44, datasheet.py:15, models.py:18, realism_bench.py:60) and by tools/sumo_realism.py:83 but is declared NEITHER in pyproject nor requirements.txt.

* Import surface is minimal: src/scms_sim_ref/__init__.py exports only __version__; mock_pipeline/__init__.py re-exports PipelineConfig, RunResult, run_pipeline, config_from_dict, validate_config, config_schema; scms_core/__init__.py re-exports the linkage API + butterfly/ec modules. There is no public "extension" namespace.
plugin_candidates: DETECTOR / MBD SCHEME (the user's 'integrate thresholding' case; highest value, cleanest seam): a Detector with .name/.keys/.score(view)->dict[str,float] invoked where detectors() is called today (run.py:3438) and where the inline detectors are computed (run.py:3450-3520); DET_KEYS (run.py:2570-2584) and featurize.DETECTORS (featurize.py:57-62) derived from the registry instead of literals. MUST be handed an MA-VISIBLE-ONLY view (b['cx'],cy,cs,ch,conf,cg,sig_ok,cvf,cvt,station_type,msg_count,rssi_dbm + receiver x/y + prior claim history) and never b['x']/b['y']/b['tspd']/b['thdg'] which ride on the same broadcast dict (run.py:3186-3189) — the leakage linter (datagen/leakage_linter.py) only checks written records, so a plugin API that hands over the whole broadcast dict would defeat the firewall by construction.

MA / DECISION POLICY: reporter gating trusted() (run.py:2592-2604), the k-reporters + distinct-seconds + persistence + window revocation gate, and resolve_and_revoke (run.py:2692-2717) — currently parameter-only (report_threshold_k, revoke_min_seconds, revoke_persist_s, revoke_window_s, ma_defense, reputation_max, report_budget). A pluggable global-MA is arguably the second product after the detector.

MOBILITY BACKEND: implement the Trip protocol (roads.py:23-100) and write cur_x/cur_y/cur_v/cur_h + finish_time per step; needs a `mobility_engine` dispatch beside the road_network dispatch (run.py:1990-2006), extraction of car_follow (run.py:2952-3055) out of the run_pipeline closure, and one call-site swap at run.py:3109-3110. Frozen-trajectory replay (docs/realism/PHASE3-PROBE.md; libsumo verified bit-deterministic, 1335 steps/s) keeps the plugin OUTSIDE the digest boundary — the trajectory file's sha256 goes in the manifest so external nondeterminism becomes a detectable input-hash change.

ROAD-NETWORK PROVIDER: promote the existing informal duck-type (nodes/center/_coord/node_phase/dist_to_road/random_trip/geometry/stats/set_closures) to a named, documented interface selectable by name; road_network='custom' (run.py:2004-2006) already proves the pattern end-to-end including validate_config integration (run.py:1567-1569).

ATTACK BEHAVIOUR: an Attack with .name/.family/.scalable/.claim(ctx)->(cx,cy,cs,ch) plus an optional .mutate_message(msg) covering the non-kinematic effects currently in the pre-pass if/elif (run.py:3146-3161), .provision(vehicle) for Sybil-style ghosts (run.py:2151-2162) and .emit_events() for DENM-style extra broadcasts (run.py:3197-3200). The base x profile x tier decomposition in AttackLib.java:64-118 is the right shared model for BOTH engines and would close the Python/Java catalogue divergence.

CHANNEL / RADIO MODEL: GeometricChannel (run.py:530-711) already has the right shape (begin_step/cbr/collision_loss/evaluate + own keyed RNG); replace the 3-way if on cfg.radio_model (run.py:3063-3065, 3325-3355) with a registry.
SENSOR / GNSS ERROR MODEL: measure() (run.py:2404-2428) — a single closure with a fixed OU-bias + white + outlier + burst + jam structure and 12 dedicated config fields.

PKI / CREDENTIAL BACKEND: an interface over {issue_pseudonyms(vehicle, life)->[cert], resolve(digest), revoke(digest)->crl_entry, is_revoked(cert_i,cert_j,lv)} implemented today by the run.py:976-1025 authority trio + make_vehicle:2095-2113 + CrlLinkageEntry.matches (linkage.py:156-172). Would let butterfly.py finally be wired in as the real 'full SCMS' implementation, alongside an ETSI TS 102 941 C-ITS variant and a null/no-PKI variant.

PSEUDONYM-CHANGE STRATEGY (separate from the PKI): period / distance-travelled / silent-period / mix-zone / event-triggered. Touches only active_pseudonym (run.py:1105-1110) and the n_rot issuance loop (run.py:2095-2109) — the smallest high-value plugin in the codebase.

OUTPUT / EXPORT WRITER: _write_outputs / _write_side_files / _write_manifest (run.py:3727-3802) hardcode file names and the data_digest set; a VeReMi-format exporter is an explicit roadmap gap (docs/realism/ROADMAP.md G15).

SCENARIO-EVENT TYPE: EVENT_TYPES (run.py:1262-1271) + _parse_events (run.py:1272-1330) + the 5 per-type closures (weather_at/ev_demand_mult/attack_wave_active/attack_zone_ok/closures, run.py:2015-2048) — small, well-bounded, and already schema-validated.
determinism_risks: SINGLE ORDERED GLOBAL STREAM. `rng = random.Random(cfg.seed)` (run.py:1943) is drawn in message-reception order for packet loss (run.py:3384), report_prob (3408, 3526, 3556) and net_delay (2611). Any plugin that draws from it — or that changes the ORDER or COUNT of in-range messages — shifts every subsequent draw and breaks the golden digest. Non-negotiable plugin rule: take `random.Random(f"{seed}:<plugin-id>:<entity-id>")`, the pattern already used at run.py:2055/2332/2938/3352.

REGISTRY ITERATION ORDER. Determinism currently rests on sorted iteration: active_list = [active[vid] for vid in sorted(active)] (run.py:3108), spawn_order sorted by (spawn_time, vid) (run.py:3075), _data_digest sorts relative paths (run.py:3773), canonical_bytes sorts JSON keys (crypto_abstract.py:39-40). A registry populated by entry-point/filesystem discovery has install-order-dependent iteration; every plugin registry must be sorted by plugin name before use, and plugin invocation order must be part of the recorded config.

DETECTOR KEY SET IS PART OF THE DIGEST. file_report writes detnorm_{k} for every k in DET_KEYS + SOFT_KEYS on EVERY report row (run.py:2641-2642), so merely ADDING a detector rewrites every row. This is why the two existing opt-in detectors are explicitly gated (vruImpersonation run.py:2578-2579, denmPlausibility run.py:2583-2584). Third-party detector columns must be off-by-default, namespaced (e.g. detnorm_x_<plugin>_<key>), and their presence + order recorded in the manifest.

ATTACK CATALOG ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. Round-robin assignment `catalog[atk_counter['n'] % len(catalog)]` (run.py:2069) means inserting a type anywhere in ATTACK_CATALOG re-labels every attacker (warning at run.py:48-52). Plugin attacks must land in an opt-in tuple appended after the frozen catalog, never inside it, and must be reachable only via explicit attack_types/attack_mix/attack_type selection.

SILENT UNKNOWN-KEY DROP DEFEATS MANIFEST REPLAY. config_from_dict (run.py:1902-1904) prints a stderr warning and continues. A manifest carrying a plugin config block would replay as a DIFFERENT run with exit code 0 — the worst failure mode for the reproducibility contract. A plugin config section must make replay FAIL LOUDLY when the plugin is missing or its version/hash differs; the manifest (run.py:3779-3802) currently records no plugin identity at all.

ENV-VAR CONFIG IS ALREADY NON-REPLAYABLE ON THE JAVA/MOSAIC PLANE — AttackLib.Cfg reads System.getenv with silent NumberFormatException fallback (AttackLib.java:225-250) and the GUI forwards any non-empty string (gui/server.py:839-853) with no validation and no manifest capture. A plugin system must not copy this pattern; plugin parameters belong in the validated, manifest-captured config.

MODULE-GLOBAL MUTABLE HOOK STATE. PER_STEP_HOOK/LANE_CHANGE_HOOK/GAP_YIELD_HOOK (run.py:1929-1937) and _ABORT (run.py:1928) are process globals; only _ABORT is reset per run (run.py:1942). In-process multi-run drivers (datagen/foundry.py, campaign.py, massive.py, gui/agent.py run_and_analyze) would cross-contaminate if plugins register the same way — plugin instances must be per-run objects, not module globals.

NUMERIC/PLATFORM DRIFT. The engine path is pure CPython float math with no numpy (numpy appears only in datagen analysis modules); outputs are round(...,3) at write time, which absorbs some but not all drift. A plugin pulling numpy/BLAS/JIT/threads can change last-bit results and therefore the digest; plugin runtime deps must be pinned and recorded.

PLUGIN-WRITTEN FILES ENTER THE DIGEST. _data_digest (run.py:3770-3776) hashes every file in the data_files map (manifest deliberately excluded, comment run.py:3782, because build_utc is wall-clock). Any plugin that writes an output file must declare whether it is data (digest-bearing, must be deterministic) or side metadata (excluded, like live_state.json).

LEAKAGE FIREWALL IS ENFORCED ONLY AT THE OUTPUT, NOT AT THE API. leakage_linter (datagen/leakage_linter.py:26-60) inspects written records for FORBIDDEN_FEATURE_KEYS (schemas/records.py:33-55). A detector plugin handed the raw broadcast dict would see b['x'], b['y'], b['tspd'], b['thdg'] and b['veh'] (the whole Vehicle object incl. is_attacker) — run.py:3186-3189 — and could launder oracle truth into a score the linter would never flag. The plugin boundary itself must be the firewall: a frozen, MA-visible-only view object, plus a static/lint check that plugin code never touches oracle attributes.
